name: rclone
description: Installs rclone, which copies, syncs, serves, and mounts files across cloud storage providers, from its signature-verified release archive, with bash, zsh, and fish completions; optionally installs the FUSE helper rclone mount needs.

version.description: rclone version to install: 'latest', or a release such as 1.76.0 (a leading 'v' is accepted; 1.63.0 or later).

installMountDependencies.description: Install fuse3, which provides the fusermount3 helper rclone mount needs. The container also needs the run-time settings the notes describe.
